proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: shrink X to a quasi-compact neighbourhood of the support, take a perfect approximation P -> F of the triple (X, F, -1); the approximation identifies Hom(F, G) with Hom_D(P, G) both over X and after base change (right exactness of h^* plus positive-degree vanishing of P); the Leray spectral sequence rewrites the functor as H^0(T, Rf_{T,*}RSheafHom(P_T, G_T)), base change for perfect input identifies this with Lg^*K for K = Rf_*RSheafHom(P, G), perfectness of K follows from G flat with proper support, and negative-degree cohomology vanishing lets the perfect-complex representability lemma finish (source lines 820-881)
